changes.summary: Schefter no longer files the same trade rumor twice. One offer could sit in his tip queue as two separate slips, and his morning catch-up read that as two stories — so the same deal went out to the chat twice, a second apart, with two different links under it.

Schefter now goes quiet from draft weekend, not from kickoff. He was still running on his full offseason volume through the busiest roster week of the year — drafts done, cuts landing — when the league already has plenty to talk about without him.

The Cap Space Rankings card on the homepage now sends you to the cap space rankings. Its arrow used to drop you on the playoff standings — a fine page, just not the one you were looking at — and it now opens League Summary already sorted by this year's cap space, top to bottom.

The AFL live scoreboard on the homepage now wears league navy instead of the blue it inherited from The League — your matchup border, the leading score and the YOUR GAME tag all match the rest of the AFL. Dark mode gets a lighter navy so the numbers still read against the navy card.
